obligations.expected_behavior: Keep all supported VDD and Acceptance package routes available for use.
forbidden_result: A supported VDD or Acceptance package route becomes unavailable.
obligations.observable_result: Requests to supported VDD and Acceptance package routes can reach an available route.
obligations.state_after: Supported VDD and Acceptance package routes remain available.
obligations.state_before: Supported VDD and Acceptance package routes are supported and available.
obligations.subject: Supported VDD and Acceptance package routes
obligations.trigger: When a supported VDD or Acceptance package route is requested

obligations.expected_behavior: Bind successful evidence to the effective inspected content produced by the route execution.
forbidden_result: Successful evidence is produced without binding to the effective inspected content.
Evidence is bound to content other than the effective inspected content.
obligations.observable_result: The successful evidence identifies or references the effective inspected content that was inspected.
obligations.state_after: Successful evidence is bound to the effective inspected content.
obligations.state_before: A supported VDD or Acceptance package route has completed successfully and produced effective inspected content.
obligations.subject: Successful route evidence and effective inspected content
obligations.trigger: When a supported VDD or Acceptance package route completes successfully
